title: Mistral gets a different engine
summary:
Mistral changed engines, Echo AI joined the project list, and a few text and image interface edges got tidied up.

The `mistral` text model now routes to `mistral-small-3.1-24b-instruct-2503` instead of the Cloudflare model, retaining its 8,192-token maximum and 0.3 temperature.

@3ch0AI’s Echo AI was added to the Tools & Interfaces list. It’s an HTML chat interface built with Pollinations text and image generation, streaming responses, and authentication.

The image editor’s inactive Imagine button now says “Write the 'Imagine' word only”; its active copy is unchanged.

highlights.title: Mistral changes engines
highlights.text: The `mistral` text model now uses `mistral-small-3.1-24b-instruct-2503`, retaining its 8,192-token maximum. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=mistral).
